The clearest signal for RIP is **practical app-growth advice paired with a visible workflow**. The tracked standout is a no-face launch-platform Reel at **54,211 views, 32× usual**. # RIP Instagram research

As of November 11, 2026. Tracked-post window: November 4-11. Nontracked discovery window: October 28-November 11. Monthly comment window: November 1-11. Dates below use Europe/Budapest.

**Coverage:** Twenty tracked candidates are listed below. The evidence does not support a verified top twenty from nontracked accounts. That section contains relevant discovery candidates instead. Comment counts are observed minima within the comments read, not totals for entire posts.

## What this means for RIP

-   **Launch help attracts founders:** the tracked launch-platform animation reached 32× usual. Its promise addresses a founder with a shipped app and no users.
-   **Show the workflow:** Jake’s app-marketing workflow reached 8.5× usual, his launch-with-no-downloads video reached 7.3×. Both show software interfaces alongside the explanation.
-   **Access dominates your comments:** RIP keyword requests recur across your recent posts. Compatibility and production questions give you more useful follow-up topics than another broad growth promise.
-   **Fix the buying path:** one commenter reports that your done-for-you menu opens mcdonalds.com. Check that link before sending more traffic there.

The recent set had 49 posts, with 21 above their creator’s median. The list retains general lifestyle posts because you asked for the tracked accounts’ strongest relative performers, rather than only their Apps & SaaS posts. Multiples are the supplied account-relative scores, current views are the highest observed counts. Some scores were recorded before those counts, so close ranks remain provisional.

**Advertising status:** paid delivery and paid-partnership status are unknown for every item below. A product pitch is identified where present, it does not establish that the post ran as an ad.

# 3\. What people ask in the comments

Scope: comments on [RIP’s account](https://www.instagram.com/getripping) last twenty listed posts, plus eleven tracked monthly reference posts. The own-post samples contained 418 entries before duplicate removal, the selected competitor samples contained 269. Repeated reads were not added together. Keyword aggregates lack individual likes, and an absent like count is marked unknown rather than zero.

**Interpretation:** keyword requests are access or resource demand. Explicit questions about obtaining the product, price or a product link are counted separately. Neither category establishes a completed purchase.

## Most frequent: send the promised access or resource

Exact recurring words include `Rip`, `rip`, `Ripping`, `admin`, `Mcp`, `MCP`, `Guide`, `Launch`, `Reel`, `toolbox` and `Ideavault`. Individual likes are unknown for these aggregated keyword comments.

-   [Your newest trial-Reel post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfkCsRMknwQ/): `RIP please 🙏` · likes unknown.
-   [Jake’s app-marketing post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfigUn1xj8_/): `MCP and please actually send it` · likes unknown. This is a delivery-friction signal.
-   [Sanskar interview](https://www.instagram.com/p/Dfh4i03vTam/): `Could you please share the link of the podcast` · 3 likes. This asks for the episode, not the app.

## Compatibility: will it work with my setup?

Three distinct visible comments across three posts.

-   [Your growth-stages post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfVnVB7jXF-/): `Can I use it with codex?` · likes unknown.
-   [Your face-versus-faceless post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfH7xYogP-_/): `Can I use ir with Codex?` · likes unknown. Earlier readings contained a spelling variation.
-   [Prachin’s YouTube-agent post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfQxYDJj4YE/): `For Android phone???` · 2 likes.

**Action:** publish a clear supported-tools and device walkthrough. Answer Codex directly rather than leaving viewers to infer compatibility from Claude-focused copy.

## Getting users: show me where to start

Three visible comments on the app-revenue analysis.

-   [Buildercult’s app-revenue post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfaBXHqSimV/): `Where do we begin?` · likes unknown.
-   Same post: `how` · likes unknown.
-   Same post: `I have, I have created my own app DeDup , how do i scale` · 3 likes.

**Action:** make a worked distribution example for a shipped app. Show the buyer problem becoming a video idea, then show the signup path.

## Creation: how did you make the animation?

Two visible comments on your posts.

-   [Your growth-stages post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfVnVB7jXF-/): `How did you do this motion graphics? Looks dope!` · likes unknown.
-   [Your defensibility post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfNDxQ7PpaK/): `Hey bro love your content am just curious which software do you use for the amazing explainer edits` · likes unknown. This is an explicit product-identification request.

**Action:** show RIP turning a founder’s app brief into a finished narrated video. Let the finished video lead into its own creation demo.

## Conversion: make the advice concrete

Two visible comments on Jake’s CTA-screen post.

-   [CTA-screen post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfXlAChNJYE/): `Do you think this applys to App Store pre-orders as well?` · likes unknown.
-   Same post: `Please show an ilustrative example because its so ambiguous` · likes unknown.

**Action:** show a real end card with the app name, reason to try it and access path. Keep the demonstration specific enough for a founder to copy the process.

## Messaging: which features should I stop leading with?

-   [Your outcome-messaging post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DffxQyBjSVQ/): `Dropping features to sell the outcome is the hardest part for solo builders. A quick test: if a feature isn't in your one-sentence description of the result, it's a deliverable, not a reason to buy. How did you decide which ones to cut first?` · likes unknown.

**Action:** demonstrate a feature-led app description rewritten around its customer’s result. Keep your suggested changes beside the founder’s original claim.

## Price: is this paid?

-   [Prachin’s cartoon-video workflow](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfjxDWmH6Np/): `Paid hai` · likes unknown. This says it is paid, it is a price objection rather than an explicit price question.

**Action:** explain the trial, subscription price and any separate software requirements together. Your offer is a 7-day free trial, then $99/month.

## Buying-path problem

-   [Your defensibility post](https://www.instagram.com/p/DfNDxQ7PpaK/): `Would you please check your website menu - when we click on done-for-you it opens mcdonalds.com rather then your website` · likes unknown.

This is a reported navigation fault. Check it immediately, the comment does not establish that the visitor intended to purchase.

# Recommended next move

**Prioritize a product-working walkthrough that answers Codex compatibility and shows how the motion graphics are created.** Put the trial terms and price beside the access step. Then follow with a worked app-video example showing its end card and signup path.

The remaining unanswered parts are the verified nontracked top twenty, exhaustive buying-intent totals for every comment thread, complete coverage of competitors’ best posts this calendar month, and definitive ad/paid-delivery status. Exact hook and format are also unconfirmed for the final tracked item and the discovery candidates identified above.
